footer.description: Experience an unforgettable day in the Grand Cul de Sac Marin, Guadeloupe's largest lagoon. Snorkeling, wild islets, and a Creole meal with your feet in the water... A day like nowhere else.

items.q: Is the meal included in the price?
items.a: Yes! The full-day cruise includes a Creole aperitif and a full meal prepared by our chef with 100% fresh produce.

items.q: Is it suitable for children and elderly people?
items.a: Absolutely. Tiki Boat is designed for all ages, from babies to seniors. The boat is stable and safe.
In the event of unfavourable weather conditions, the trip is postponed or fully refunded. Your safety comes first.
Online on this website (secure payment), by WhatsApp at +590 690 49 58 48, or by phone.
